rows.formula: exp(i*(omega*t))*(((exp(-i*k_x*x + i*(k_y*y)) - exp(i*(k_x*x) + i*(k_y*y))) - exp(-i*k_x*x - i*k_y*y)) + exp(i*(k_x*x) - i*k_y*y))

split_policy: One seeded permutation of fluid-labelled IDs, cut into six consecutive folds. Keep the prior fold for each non-fluid ID. Each fluid ID keeps all labels in its new fold.
training_policy: Keep the original representatives and held-out folds. Exclude test IDs and formulas in the same reviewed group as a test formula.
